# Sharpen

Shrinks selected splats to make soft details crisper.

`lfs.sharpen` · Splat

## How to use

Start with Amount 0.25 and leave Keep Coverage on.  
High amounts can reveal gaps between splats.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Where you apply the edit, 0–1: 0 leaves it unchanged, 1 applies it fully. Unconnected means everything. |
| Amount | `Amount` | lfs.float | 0.25 | min 0; max 0.95; step 0.01 | Size reduction, 0–0.95. 0 does nothing; 0.25, the default, shrinks each axis by 25%. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keep Coverage | `keep_coverage` | bool | true | — | Increase opacity as splats shrink to keep coverage. On by default; off can make the result more transparent. |
